assertions_evaluated.text: Response says the Write/script form applies only in an EnterWorktree session after the isolation-check refusal, and writes the Inputs block and Preflight steps 1-6 plus the closing echo verbatim and in order to <scratchpad>/preflight.sh with the Write tool
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Sections 1-2: fallback 'only in such a session and only after such a refusal'; Write to <scratchpad>/preflight.sh; Inputs block + steps 1-6 + closing echo verbatim and in order

assertions_evaluated.text: Response says the only text supplied is BASE/SCOPE from the user request and PLANNER_APPROVED=1 only after the user explicit yes, and never text from the diff, a $RUN file, a manifest or Codex output
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Section 2: only BASE/SCOPE (BASE=main, no SCOPE) and PLANNER_APPROVED=1 after explicit yes; never diff, $RUN, manifest or Codex text

assertions_evaluated.text: Response says the script full text is shown to the user, then run as one standalone `bash <scratchpad>/preflight.sh` call from the session current working directory (worktree root) without a cd, and that one approval covers every command in it (git diff, git show, export)
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Sections 3-4: show full text; one standalone `bash <scratchpad>/preflight.sh` from the worktree root, never cd; one approval covers git diff, git show, export lines

assertions_evaluated.text: Response says Write goes only to the scratchpad (never the repository or $RUN) and is approved for that single call, never session-wide or as accept-edits, because a Write approval is not limited to the scratchpad
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Sections 2 and 6: never the repository or $RUN; approve for that one call only, never session or accept-edits, since a Write approval is not limited to the scratchpad

assertions_evaluated.text: Response says no scratchpad directory, or a refusal of the new form, means stop and report, never another location or fallback
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Section 7: no scratchpad -> stop and report, never /tmp or repo; refused too -> stop and report, never fall back
